en: A sepia-toned photograph of a large formal assembly or congress held in a richly decorated hall. Dozens of men in early 20th‑century suits sit at long tables covered with documents, while a group of officials preside from an elevated, flower‑decorated stage under a grand proscenium with curtains and drapery. Large ceremonial banners hang in the foreground and to the left, one bearing an allegorical female figure. The overall style suggests an important political or organizational congress captured as a commemorative image.
